reason: The text explicitly demonstrates Yahweh's goal to help the Hebrew people. God states He has heard the cry of the children of Israel (צַעֲקַת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּאָה אֵלַי) and has seen their oppression by the Egyptians (רָאִיתִי אֶת־הַלַּחַץ אֲשֶׁר מִצְרַיִם לֹחֲצִים אֹתָם). God then explicitly commissions Moses to bring forth His people from Egypt (וְהוֹצֵא אֶת־עַמִּי בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִמִּצְרַיִם). This is the foundational expression of divine purpose to liberate and assist the Hebrew people.
